name: Metamagic Rod, Eclipsed
body:
Price varies: lesser 1,500 gp; standard 5,500 gp; greater 12,250 gp; Slot none; CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.; Aura strong (no school)

DESCRIPTION

The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that alter how the spell raises or lowers the illumination level in their affected areas as though using the Eclipsed Spell feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost varies: lesser 750 gp; standard 2,750 gp; greater 6,125 gp; Feats Craft Rod, Eclipsed Spell
